platformRegions.intro: The regions the platform runs nodes in. Each has a description and one or more purposes that say why it exists, and the data addresses the UI sends that region's data calls to.
platformRegions.restartNote: Changes on this page take effect when the nodes restart: the platform's regions, the default grant, and each organization's regions and stores.
platformRegions.restartPending: Saved. The nodes keep running on what they read before until they restart.
platformRegions.idHelp: A short lowercase name, such as eu or us. A node is started in one region.
platformRegions.deleteConsequence: Region {{id}} is removed from the platform when the nodes restart. If organizations are granted it, they are listed before anything is removed.
platformRegions.sandboxNote: This page is shown in the demo to explain regions. It cannot be changed here.
platformRegions.defaultGrantIntro: The regions every new organization is granted, with the store it keeps each kind of data in there, so a new organization starts with a working region.
platformRegions.orgsIntro: Which regions an organization uses is decided here: grant it regions and assign the store it keeps each kind of data in there.
platformRegions.noDataAddresses: None: the UI is offered the region's registered nodes.
platformRegions.descriptionHelp: What the region is, in a sentence.
platformRegions.purposesHelp: Why the region exists. Purposes explain; they do not change where queries run or what is allowed.
platformRegions.dataAddressesHelp: Where the UI sends this region's data calls: a load balancer, a pool or a single node, each an http(s) URL. With none, the UI is offered the region's registered nodes.
platformRegions.affectedOrgs: Region {{id}} is granted to {{orgs}}. Removing it takes it from them when the nodes restart.
